title: The healthy hemisphere is the ruler
question: Under normalization frozen from each unedited case, does an ISLES'24 final-infarct model use contralateral perfusion as a signed patient-specific reference when judging the affected hemisphere, beyond global gain control and non-reference cross-hemispheric effects?
deliverable_original: The model is using the healthy hemisphere as the patient's personal perfusion baseline -- the same relative-to-mirror normalization radiologists apply when they read relative CBF -- rather than absolute map values.
deliverable_sentence: The model is using the healthy hemisphere as a signed patient-specific perfusion reference when judging the affected hemisphere's deficit.
why_it_matters: Contralateral normalization is clinically established for perfusion CT. If a plain infarct model learns that reference, one part of its decision becomes physician-legible; if it does not, the result tests the rationale for explicitly supplying symmetry or relative-perfusion features.

claim_boundaries.claimed_after_a_valid_positive: Only that the tested frozen model uses a signed contralateral comparison as a patient-specific reference for its affected-side prediction.
not_claimed: That the model computes affected CBF divided by mean contralateral CBF, the Campbell threshold, or any specific ratio.
That the result generalizes to unreleased ISLES'24 challenge systems or other preprocessing pipelines.
That contralateral information use alone establishes reference-setting.
That a null implies reliance on absolute perfusion values or fragility to cardiac output or injection variation.
That scanner, protocol, site, or population artifacts have been eliminated beyond this within-case intervention.

rung.why: No valid intervention has run. Rung 1 requires the full signed-response conjunction after every preprocessing, realism, emergence, and power gate passes; rung 2 requires acquisition and site robustness; rung 3 is the named signed contralateral-reference sentence.
rung.what_would_move_it_up: A preregistered, adequately powered, within-case intervention must show a signed monotone affected-side response to bidirectional contralateral scaling, especially increased predicted deficit under healthy-side up-scaling, no emergent contralateral lesion, and a contralateral-only response exceeding the global-scaling response by a frozen margin. An independent methods review must first confirm from a prediction table that the named non-reference mechanisms cannot satisfy this conjunction.

X_measurement.X: Contralateral perfusion reference level: automatically measured mean CBF and CBV within the unaffected hemisphere after automatic midsagittal-plane estimation and exclusion of low-quality or bilaterally abnormal cases.
X_measurement.how: Estimate the midsagittal plane automatically in NCCT space, define hemispheres and the affected side from the released outcome mask only for cohort construction, and compute contralateral CBF/CBV summaries from the registered maps. The intervention scales contralateral CBF and CBV jointly within a prespecified empirical envelope.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes. The measurement uses registered images, automatic geometry, and fixed summary statistics; no radiologist concept annotation is required. Actual orientation, grid, midline, and bilateral-abnormality QC remain Stage 0 gates.

suspected_signal: Because deconvolved perfusion values are semi-quantitative, a signed comparison with the same patient's unaffected hemisphere may be more stable than an affected-side value alone. Campbell et al. provide the clinical motivation, but the experiment tests only the broader reference function, not their exact ratio.
specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Per-edited-tensor normalization can arithmetically transmit a contralateral edit into affected-side network inputs. Unilateral scaling can also create cross-channel inconsistency or resemble contralateral vascular disease, activating bilateral-lesion detection, laterality competition, or unsigned anomaly responses.
keystone_prerequisite: There must be an adequately powered contralateral up-scaling range that passes frozen final-tensor and cross-channel realism gates, leaves affected-side network-input voxels bit-identical, and yields a preregistered response conjunction not shared by laterality competition, bilateral-lesion detection, unsigned anomaly response, or generic contralateral context.
keystone_evidence: Primary sources establish NCCT-space registration of the released perfusion maps (ISLES'24 Zenodo record 16813698; DOI 10.1148/ryai.250603), and nnU-Net documentation establishes that non-CT channels normally receive per-case z-score normalization. Neither source establishes a valid up-scaling envelope, adequate power, or uniqueness of the proposed conjunction in the actual frozen pipeline.
keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? Co-registration and documented normalization behavior do not establish edit/readout disjointness after the complete chosen preprocessing, physiological and cross-modal plausibility of unilateral up-scaling, sufficient detectable effect, or exclusion of all non-reference mechanisms. Those are the load-bearing facts and remain uninspected.
rung_reached: No rung. Passing Stage 0 authorizes a future probe contract; it is not evidence that the model uses X.

stage_0_gate.timing: Before any confirmatory edited-case score is examined, freeze the model and split, normalization constants, scaling doses, prediction table, numeric realism and emergence thresholds, mirror-over-global margin, trend test, equivalence logic, exclusions, and minimum-detectable-effect calculation.
inspect: Pipeline disjointness: compute normalization constants from each unedited case and reuse them for every variant; verify bit-for-bit identity of every affected-side network-input voxel after contralateral-only editing.

Mechanism identifiability: an independent methods review must tabulate the predicted sign under contralateral down-scaling, contralateral up-scaling, and global scaling for reference-setting, laterality competition, bilateral-lesion detection, unsigned mismatch, and generic context; any surviving non-reference false positive pauses the idea.

Edit validity: define an empirical bidirectional CBF/CBV scaling envelope and require every retained dose to pass final-tensor distribution checks, a held-out real-versus-edited discriminator, and explicit CBF/CBV consistency checks against frozen Tmax, CTA, and NCCT.
Emergence: freeze a contralateral predicted-lesion-volume threshold; a breach invalidates that case-dose rather than becoming evidence.

Power: estimate within-case response variability on development data without inspecting confirmatory effects; require enough clean held-out cases to detect the frozen signed-slope and mirror-over-global margins.
stage_0_gate.decision: GO to a probe contract only if every gate passes. Failure of mechanism identifiability, a usable up-scaling envelope, or power pauses the reference-setting question. No probe code is authorized by this card.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: For one frozen self-trained model and untouched held-out cases, reuse unedited-case normalization constants and apply joint CBF/CBV scaling in three paired arms: contralateral-only bidirectional scaling, both-hemisphere global scaling, and partial-area contralateral scaling. Read affected- and contralateral-side predicted lesion volumes. Shams match the image operation without changing perfusion level.
smallest_decisive_experiment.primary_positive_conjunction: Affected-side predicted deficit changes monotonically with contralateral scale in the prespecified signed direction, including an increase under healthy-side up-scaling; no retained dose produces an emergent contralateral lesion; and the contralateral-only effect exceeds the global effect by the frozen margin.
smallest_decisive_experiment.positive_interpretation: Conditional rung-1 evidence that the tested model uses a signed contralateral reference rather than only global gain control, provided independent review has shown that the listed non-reference mechanisms cannot meet the conjunction.
smallest_decisive_experiment.negative_interpretation: If all gates pass and confidence bounds exclude the frozen minimum signed slope or mirror-over-global margin, the result decisively weakens material use of this reference by the tested model. Mere non-significance is sensitivity-limited.

use_vs_association: The primary evidence is within-case intervention, not cross-case association. Raw spatial separation is insufficient: the normalization pin and bit-identity gate are required to prevent preprocessing arithmetic from creating the effect. Natural cross-case baseline dependence may be exploratory only and cannot establish use.

named_alternatives: Laterality competition or bilateral-lesion detection caused by apparent contralateral hypoperfusion.
Unsigned hemispheric anomaly detection with separate laterality assignment.
Generic contralateral context or whole-image gain control without reference-setting.
Cross-channel or out-of-distribution response to unilateral perfusion-map editing.
claim_identifiability.what_the_design_rules_out: The up-scaling sign and contralateral-emergence gate target competition and bilateral-lesion explanations; the required sign targets unsigned anomaly response; the contralateral-over-global margin targets global gain control; the discriminator and cross-channel checks target edit artifacts. Independent prediction-table review is mandatory because this exclusion logic remains disputed.
claim_identifiability.standing_confounds: Within-case pairing fixes patient, scanner, vendor, site, acquisition protocol, reconstruction, positioning, habitus, disease prevalence, referral pathway, and report-label leakage for the causal contrast. It does not establish transportability across those factors. Frozen Tmax, CTA, and NCCT create an edit-consistency problem rather than a confound and are handled by explicit validity gates.

dies_like_prior: The nearest prior is idea 006: an out-of-distribution intervention could mimic model reliance. This candidate differs only if a nontrivial bidirectional scaling envelope passes final-tensor, discriminator, and cross-channel gates; otherwise it dies the same way. It also faces the recurrent wrong-keystone error: registration was verified, while normalization-path disjointness, mechanism uniqueness, realism, and power are the actual prerequisites. No annotation-provenance failure applies because X and the primary readout are automatic and label-free.

closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The study evaluated perfusion CT definitions and reported relative CBF referenced to mean contralateral CBF as the best-performing tested core definition.
closest_prior_work.delta: It establishes clinical motivation and a measurable reference, not whether a learned infarct model uses it.

closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The challenge evaluates final-infarct prediction and reports weak, variable segmentation performance.
closest_prior_work.delta: It does not intervene on contralateral perfusion or identify a model's reference frame.

closest_prior_work.citation: Zhao et al., symmetric modality augmentation
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The inspected primary preprint explicitly supplies contralateral symmetry information to improve brain-lesion segmentation.
closest_prior_work.delta: It motivates the question but does not test whether a plain model learned a contralateral reference unaided.

novelty_statement: No novelty claim is made. A targeted search found adjacent symmetry-engineering and stroke-model literature but no direct intervention-grade reference-frame audit; absence was not exhaustively established.

anticipated_negative.classification: decisive only after all validity and power gates pass
anticipated_negative.meaningful_negative: Confidence bounds excluding the preregistered minimum signed up-scaling slope or mirror-over-global margin meaningfully weaken material use of a signed contralateral reference by this frozen model under the pinned preprocessing.
anticipated_negative.non_decisive_negative: Non-significance, insufficient power, failure to find a realistic up-scaling range, an emergent contralateral lesion, discriminator failure, or loss of affected-side bit identity is uninterpretable about model use. None implies absolute-value reliance.

data_and_compute.data: ISLES'24 public noncommercial release, 149 cases, with NCCT-space registered CBF, CBV, MTT, Tmax, and outcome masks. Actual NIfTI geometry, usable unilateral cases, and clean held-out count remain Stage 0 measurements.
data_and_compute.model: One self-trained, frozen model with a completely specified preprocessing pipeline. It is not presented as the challenge winner or as representative of unreleased submissions.
data_and_compute.compute: Training plus limited paired inference is plausibly compatible with Colab Pro+, but the required clean sample and power are not yet established.

remaining_legwork: Obtain independent methods review of the arm-by-mechanism prediction table and resolve whether any non-reference mechanism survives the proposed conjunction.
Inspect actual NIfTI headers, orientation, midsagittal-plane reliability, bilateral abnormalities, and held-out case count.
Freeze the training and inference normalization so all edited variants reuse unedited-case constants, then verify affected-side final-tensor bit identity.
Find and freeze a bidirectional scaling envelope that passes cross-channel realism and discriminator gates.
Complete a blinded minimum-detectable-effect memo and prespecify every numeric margin before any confirmatory scoring.
If only contralateral-information use remains testable, stop and seek a human claim-identity ruling before registering a successor; do not weaken this card in place.

clarity.why: One frozen model and one signed reference-setting question are specified, but the positive conjunction still needs independent mechanism review.

identifiability.why: Normalization pin, signed up-scaling, emergence, global-arm, and realism controls target the main alternatives; uniqueness of the conjunction is not yet inspected.

medical_relevance.why: The study tests whether a stroke model recovers a clinically meaningful patient-specific reference frame.

interest.why: It asks whether an unaided model discovers the mirror convention that other systems explicitly engineer.

prior_legwork.why: Registered public maps and clinical and symmetry precedents exist, but no official recipe or released winning checkpoint exists and a model must be trained.

feasibility.why: Capped because the real keystone is NOT_INSPECTED; up-scaling realism and adequate power may fail.

data_readiness.why: The public noncommercial release contains registered modalities, but usable-case counts and array-level geometry need inspection.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired trends and lesion-volume readouts are straightforward, while margins, realism thresholds, and the mechanism prediction table remain to be frozen.

negative_result_value.why: A powered equivalence-style negative after every gate would decisively weaken material mirror-reference use for the tested model; invalid or underpowered nulls are explicitly excluded.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped by the uninspected keystone and a targeted rather than exhaustive primary-source search.

regret.why: The reference-frame question is obvious in hindsight and can clarify whether symmetry should be engineered, but its intervention is not yet validated.

unverified_claims: The signed up-scaling conjunction uniquely distinguishes reference-setting from every named non-reference mechanism.
A nontrivial contralateral up-scaling envelope remains in distribution across all input channels.
Enough clean held-out cases exist to detect the frozen slope and mirror-specificity margins.
Automatic midsagittal-plane and bilateral-abnormality QC are reliable in the released cohort.
No prior intervention-grade audit exists beyond the bounded search.
recommendation: REVISE COMPLETE; remain at rung 0. Independent mechanism review and a feasibility memo are required before any probe contract. No code or inference is authorized.
